name: Task or feature
about: Define a bounded change and its acceptance criteria

## Goal

Describe the user-visible result or technical problem.

## Scope

- List the required changes and relevant constraints.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State an observable, testable completion condition.

## Dependencies

Link prerequisite issues and assign the relevant milestone.

## Verification

Describe the relevant public boundary or user flow to check. Record actual
commands and results in the linked pull request when implementation is complete.
